data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced material prior-year adverse reserve movement at the 2019 year-end. Gross claims development analysis shows substantial strengthening across older years (notably 2013 and 2016) driven by catastrophe losses, liability reserve increases and deterioration in specialty loss ratios, plus late development on 2015. Overall the prior-year re-estimation amounts to approximately GBP 58.4m adverse movement (strengthening), driven primarily by natural catastrophe and large-loss development concentrated in property and liability-related lines.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (cumulative gross claims incurred by underwriting year) by excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2019 and 2018) and summing the diagonal changes for 2013-2017. No single gross prior-year 'movement in prior year's provision' line with an explicit gross total was provided; hence the triangle was used as primary source. Triangle and other numbers are presented in thousands in the report; amounts here converted to millions. RITC activity is present in the underwriting year accounts but does not appear to distort the gross triangle for the UW years used; confidence set accordingly.
